usedFor: Trint produces transcripts, and Asana turns them into work when “New Transcript” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript” in Trint, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each ready transcript becomes an Asana task, so someone owns the review.

watchOut: “New Transcript” fires when a transcript is ready, not verified, so use “Verified Transcript” for approved text.
